title: Localized tensor comparison retract component
statement: Under the hypotheses of localized tensor comparison closure, if X is a retract of Y and Y satisfies the predicate, then each fixed representative/model/degree comparison for X is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Fix the representative U, its isomorphism to X, its K-flatness, its model mU and degree i. Choose a cochain representative L of Y using essential surjectivity of DerivedCategory.Q. Apply the reduced functorial flat resolution of ModuleCat A to L. Its augmentation s is a quasi-isomorphism, and kFlat_resolutionFunctor_obj proves its source V is K-flat. The equivalence kFlat_quotient_obj_iff and kFlat_iff_preserves_acyclic gives the exact acyclic-test formulation required by the predicate. Q(s) and the representative isomorphism give Q(V) isomorphic to Y. Choose a base-derived model mV of V tensor Q by its existing Nonempty theorem.
Apply the derived-arrow theorem at degree i to obtain H and arrow isomorphisms eU and eV identifying the comparisons for U and V with H(Q(U)) and H(Q(V)).

Conjugate hXY with the representative isomorphisms to get Retract Q(U) Q(V), map it by H, and conjugate again with eU and eV to get a retract between the two displayed comparison arrows. Apply hY to V, its representative isomorphism, its K-flatness and mV to obtain IsIso for the comparison of V. Mathlib MorphismProperty.of_retract for the isomorphisms property proves IsIso for the comparison of U. This constructs the retract and uses its identities; no remaining closure assertion is assumed.

theorem localizedTensorComparisonProperty_retract_core
    (hQ : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V Q (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    {X Y : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)} (hXY : Retract X Y)
    (hY : localizedTensorComparisonProperty R A B C Q N t Y) :
    ∀ (U : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ),
    Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj U ≅ X) →
    (∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V U (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic) →
    ∀ (mU : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U ⊗ Q) C) (i : ℤ),
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)
    IsIso (mU.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F U Q).inv ≫ (F.obj U ◁ t)) i)
